metadata.purpose: PA-GEO-08 held-out benchmark for matcher v2: records neither matcher's design saw
metadata.method: Eligible records minus every record of PA-GEO-04's and PA-GEO-05's samples, one stratum each by first matching rule, a fixed number per stratum (or all of a smaller one), within a stratum in ascending sha256(seed:ACTIVETRANSPORTID).
metadata.size_rationale: About 190 records, weighted to what matcher v1 could not settle. Curb cuts get 90 across six strata, most of them where OSM has no kerb node, because that is where 1,152 City curb cuts wait. Stairs get every eligible record not already used: only 17 remain after PA-GEO-05 took 20, so stair results will rest on those alone and are reported as such. Corner and junction pieces get 26, structures up to 24. Small control strata (curb cuts with a kerb node and no crossing, parallel facilities, straightforward records) are there to show a regression where v1 did well. The ceiling is review cost: every record is labelled blind, and 60 twice. The size carries no claim of statistical certainty.

eligibility.excludes: records sourced from street-level imagery; records not wholly inside the study box shrunk by 50 m

stairs_explicit_steps.rule: City STAIRS with an OSM highway=steps way beside half of it (within 3 m)

stairs_displaced_steps.rule: City STAIRS with an OSM highway=steps way within 25 m that does not run beside it

stairs_generic_footway.rule: City STAIRS with no OSM steps within 25 m and a plain footway or path beside half of it

structure_split.rule: bridges, overpasses, underpasses and boardwalks across two or more OSM ways

structure_other.rule: every other bridge, overpass, underpass and boardwalk

curb_cut_sub_metre.rule: CURBCUT = Y pieces shorter than 1 m

curb_cut_no_kerb_junction.rule: CURBCUT = Y, no OSM kerb node within 2 m, two or more OSM pedestrian ways within 3 m

curb_cut_no_kerb_single_way.rule: CURBCUT = Y, no OSM kerb node within 2 m, one OSM pedestrian way within 3 m

curb_cut_no_kerb_no_way.rule: CURBCUT = Y with no OSM kerb node within 2 m and no OSM pedestrian way within 3 m

curb_cut_kerb_onto_crossing.rule: CURBCUT = Y with an OSM kerb node and an OSM crossing way within 2 m

curb_cut_kerb_other.rule: every other CURBCUT = Y record: a kerb node near and no crossing way

corner_junction_piece.rule: pieces shorter than 5 m, not curb cuts, with two or more OSM pedestrian ways within 3 m

crossing_as_node.rule: City crossings with an OSM crossing node within 3 m and no OSM crossing way within 5 m

parallel_facilities.rule: two or more OSM pedestrian ways running beside the record

hard_negative.rule: no OSM footway, path, crossing or steps within 5 m

short_other.rule: every other piece shorter than 5 m

metadata.coordinates: OGC:CRS84, rounded to 7 decimal places (about 1 cm) for inspection
